title: Embed window `suspend/pause` doesn't stop awaited coroutines
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.1.stable.mono.official [14d19694e]

### System information

Windows 10 - Foward+ - Nividia 1070

### Issue description

The pause/suspend button of embed windows doesn't seem to affect **await coroutines.**
Here is a basic example. After pausing the game, the coroutine keeps running and executing the code. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fdf12a6e-ebe9-4aed-871b-2b5e86df82b6

Here is a more real example of how bad this can become. 
The object stops but the camera keeps shaking even though the embed window is paused. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fdf2fd5d-4d7a-4e81-bc42-8a0fbac8f542

**Not sure if this is a limitation of the embed window or a bug that no one noticed yet.**
But if your game depends on coroutines, the pause/step function doesn't quite work as a debug tool. 
As it'll give very inconsistent results and break a lot of things in the game when stepping frame by frame.

**Note:**
Using `await get_tree().create_timer(0.05).timeout` instead of `await get_tree().process_frame` would **kinda** work.
It seems the suspend/pause stops the timer creation/update, so the code would stop when it encounters that. 
But would still execute until that point when paused.

### Steps to reproduce

Steps:
1. Create a code with a long coroutine (multiple frames, eg: await get_tree().process_frame)
2. Execute the game with the embed menu
3. Pause/Suspend the embed game window while the coroutine is still running

**Result:** Coroutine keeps running even tho embed window is paused
**Expected Result:** Coroutine paused like process function

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

MRP Steps:
1. Execute the project
2. Pause the game window

**Results:** Camera keeps shaking
**Expected**: Camera shake stops

[suspend embed.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25397999/suspend.embed.zip)
